model_name: Early post-EVT 90-day unfavorable functional outcome model
outcome: 90-day unfavorable functional outcome (modified Rankin Scale score 3-6)
population: Adults with anterior circulation large-vessel-occlusion acute ischemic stroke treated with endovascular thrombectomy, pre-stroke modified Rankin Scale score 0-1, and evaluable through the 3-day postprocedural assessment window
prediction_timing: After all seven predictors from the first 3 days after EVT are available

predictors.label: C-reactive protein (CRP)
predictors.timing: Blood sample collected within 24 hours after EVT

predictors.label: Lymphocyte count
predictors.timing: Blood sample collected within 24 hours after EVT

predictors.label: Neutrophil count
predictors.timing: Blood sample collected within 24 hours after EVT

predictors.label: Early neurological deterioration (END)
predictors.definition: Increase of at least 2 points in NIHSS score within 3 days after EVT compared with the preprocedural score

predictors.label: Cerebral edema
predictors.definition: Evaluated within 3 days after EVT and diagnosed by neurologists according to postoperative CT reports together with corresponding clinical manifestations

notes: The ui_min and ui_max values are broad plausibility guardrails, not reported training-cohort ranges.
The 0.50 threshold reported in the study was descriptive and is not an established clinical decision threshold.
Coefficients retain the unrounded precision exported from the final model; Supplementary Table S6 presents rounded display values.
